title: Core concepts + Student factors and characteristics
queryText: (digital learning OR e-learning adoption OR online learning OR technology-enhanced learning OR learning management systems) AND (student attitudes OR digital literacy OR self-efficacy OR motivation OR learning preferences OR generational differences)
description: Find literature covering how student characteristics, attitudes, and digital competencies influence digital learning adoption and outcomes.

title: Core concepts + Institutional and infrastructure
queryText: (digital learning OR e-learning adoption OR online learning OR technology-enhanced learning OR learning management systems) AND (institutional support OR technical infrastructure OR internet access OR broadband connectivity OR device availability)
description: Find literature on the institutional, infrastructure, and access requirements that enable or constrain digital learning implementation.

title: Core concepts + Pedagogical and instructional design
queryText: (digital learning OR e-learning adoption OR online learning OR technology-enhanced learning OR learning management systems) AND (course design OR teaching methods OR interactive content OR instructional quality OR assessment strategies)
description: Find literature covering instructional design, teaching approaches, and assessment methods in digital learning environments.

title: Core concepts + Socioeconomic and contextual barriers
